concepts.definition: The set of decisions that connects content to a business goal: audience, problem, form, channels, cadence and metrics.
Three to five topics where the company has expertise and the audience has need.
A number that grows without saying anything about the goal.

questions.q: A program aims to generate demo requests. Which metric is primary, and which is a vanity metric?
questions.a: Demo requests attributed to content are primary; total page views are a vanity metric for this goal.

questions.q: Why is a strategy described as a hypothesis?
questions.a: It is a bet about what the audience needs and what will work, tested against results and revised.

questions.q: Why is a short written plan better than a long one?
questions.a: One or two pages get read and used; long documents are ignored.
